metadata.title: Urban Monochromatic Portrait with Damask Texture

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban portrait featuring a central figure in streetwear against a textured damask background, unified by a deep red monochromatic color grade.
excludeWhen: minimalist or airy compositions are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a man in a baseball cap and leather jacket, rendered in a saturated red-and-black duotone. The background features a subtle, ornate damask pattern, and the bottom third is occupied by bold, interlocking sans-serif typography with metallic gradients.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a circular vignette
Monochromatic red wash unifying subject and background
Heavy, blocky typography anchored at the bottom
Contrast between modern streetwear and classical damask patterns
coreInvariants: Deep red and black monochromatic color scheme
Subtle damask wallpaper texture in the background
Heavyweight sans-serif display type with tight tracking

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, waist-up, filling the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hands framing the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright cap down to the face, following the arms to the large-scale typography at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, vignetted corners with textured damask in the mid-ground.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in reds with crushed blacks for a dramatic, moody effect.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly monochromatic red and black for the image

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking with overlapping characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the secondary line contains a heart symbol
The 'S' is reduced in scale to fit between words
The 'O' in the third word contains a currency symbol
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying scales and integrated icons.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight.
Geometric structure matches the modern urban feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a baseball cap and leather jacket, centered, with a deep red monochromatic filter. The background should have a subtle dark red damask wallpaper pattern and a heavy black vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, extra-bold sans-serif text at the bottom. Use a silver-to-grey vertical gradient for the fill. Ensure letters are touching or overlapping.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly red and black?
Is the damask pattern visible but subtle in the background?
Is the typography heavy and centered at the bottom?
Do the letters in the main title overlap?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red color wash
Thickness of the metallic text outline

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of subject and background texture

postGenerationChecks: Check for monochromatic consistency across the subject and background.
Verify the damask pattern does not distract from the subject's face.
Ensure the metallic gradient on the text has a clear vertical transition.
Confirm the typography is large enough to anchor the composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Monochromatic Wash + Damask Texture + Heavy Overlapping Sans-Serif
